extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, IP managers, in-house counsel, and clients budgeting/procuring patent prosecution, post-grant, and litigation services
extracted.subtask_description: A catalog/toc of discrete patent-related work items and matter-types (prosecution, foreign filing, post-allowance formalities, opinions, litigation phases, PTAB proceedings, transactional work, and related administrative tasks) intended for use in fee/price surveys or budgeting. Each line-item names a specific service or matter-phase that can be estimated, priced, or evaluated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparing and Filing Assignments or Other Formal Documents (Q39l)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing and filing assignments or other formal documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; no further detail on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original non‑provisional utility patent application, minimal complexity (Preparation and Filing) (Q40a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation and filing of an original (not divisional, continuation, or CIP) non‑provisional utility patent application for an invention of minimal complexity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under US Utility Patents by Location/Type; used as a baseline matter-type for pricing/estimation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provisional Patent Application (Preparation and Filing) (Q40b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation and filing of a provisional patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry for fee/price survey item.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original utility application, relatively complex biotechnology/chemical (Preparation and Filing) (Q40c)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation and filing of an original utility application of relatively high complexity in biotechnology or chemical arts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes complexity and tech sector for pricing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original utility application, relatively complex electrical/computer (Preparation and Filing) (Q40d)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation and filing of an original utility application of relatively high complexity in electrical or computer arts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tech-specific pricing category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original utility application, relatively complex mechanical (Preparation and Filing) (Q40e)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation and filing of an original utility application of relatively high complexity in mechanical arts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tech-specific pricing category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent application amendment/argument of minimal complexity (Preparation and Filing) (Q40f)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation and filing of an amendment/argument in a patent application of minimal complexity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prosecution action baseline matter-type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent application amendment/argument, relatively complex, biotechnology/chemical (Q40g)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation and filing of a relatively complex amendment/argument in biotechnology/chemical prosecution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Differentiates by complexity and tech area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent application amendment/argument, relatively complex, electrical/computer (Q40h)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation and filing of a relatively complex amendment/argument in electrical/computer prosecution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Differentiates by complexity and tech area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent application amendment/argument, relatively complex, mechanical (Q40i)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation and filing of a relatively complex amendment/argument in mechanical prosecution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Differentiates by complexity and tech area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeal to Board in utility patent application without oral argument (Q40j)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing and filing an appeal to the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) in a utility patent application where no oral argument is held.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Post-final/prosecution appeal matter-type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeal to Board in utility patent application with oral argument (Q40k)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing and filing an appeal to the PTAB in a utility patent application where oral argument is conducted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes oral argument component for pricing differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issuing an allowed application (All post‑allowance activity) (Q40l)
rubrics_metrics.description: All post-allowance activities required to issue an allowed patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers prosecution steps after allowance through issuance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ex parte re‑exam (Q40m)
rubrics_metrics.description: Handling an ex parte reexamination proceeding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Post-grant challenge procedural matter-type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paying a Maintenance Fee (Q40n)
rubrics_metrics.description: Handling payment of a patent maintenance/renewal fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative maintenance task.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utility Patent Novelty Search, Analysis, and Opinion (Q40o)
rubrics_metrics.description: Conducting a novelty search for a utility patent, analyzing results, and delivering an opinion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search and opinion engagement; used for clearance/prior-art assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validity/Invalidity Only Opinion, per patent (Q40p)
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing an opinion solely on validity or invalidity for a single patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Opinion-only engagement focusing on validity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Infringement/Non‑Infringement Only Opinion, per patent (Q40q)
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing an opinion solely on infringement or non‑infringement for a single patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Opinion-only engagement focusing on infringement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combination Validity and Infringement, per patent (Q40r)
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing combined opinions on both validity and infringement for a single patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive opinion engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparing and filing Information Disclosure Statement (IDS), <50 references (Q40s)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing and filing an IDS with fewer than 50 references.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative/prosecution filing categorized by number of references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparing and filing Information Disclosure Statement (IDS), >50 references (Q40t)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing and filing an IDS with more than 50 references.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Larger IDS filings separated for pricing complexity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference management (typical portfolio size) (Q40u)
rubrics_metrics.description: Managing prior-art/reference collections for a typical patent portfolio size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Portfolio-level administrative/knowledge-management task.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Term Adjustment calculation (Q40v)
rubrics_metrics.description: Calculating Patent Term Adjustment (PTA) amounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative/analysis task for patent term accounting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formalities: declarations, assignments, POAs, pre‑examination notices, corrections (Q40w)
rubrics_metrics.description: Handling formalities including preparing and filing formal declarations, assignments, powers of attorney, responding to pre‑examination notices, and preparing papers to make corrections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Catch-all formalities category for prosecution administrative work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparing and filing formal drawings (Q40x)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing and filing formal patent drawings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specialized drafting/drawing task.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparing for and conducting examiner interview (Q40y)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing for and conducting interviews with patent examiners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interview prep and conduct as a discrete prosecution activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Providing a continuation recommendation (including proposed claim strategy) (Q40z)
rubrics_metrics.description: Advice and recommendation on filing a continuation, including proposed claim strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strategic prosecution counseling matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing foreign‑origin utility patent application in USPTO, ready for filing with formal papers, assignment, and priority documents (Q41a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Filing a foreign‑origin utility patent application in the USPTO when received ready for filing with necessary formal papers, assignment, and priority documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foreign-origin filing handled in US office; administrative readiness assumed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing non‑PCT patent application abroad (per country) (Q41b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Filing a non‑PCT patent application abroad, cost estimated per country (excluding associate or government fees).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foreign filing per-jurisdiction matter-type for fee surveys.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing previously prepared US patent application as PCT in US Receiving Office (Q41c)
rubrics_metrics.description: Filing a US-prepared patent application as a PCT application in the US Receiving Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PCT filing administration from US origin.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entering National Stage in US Receiving Office from foreign-origin PCT (Q41d)
rubrics_metrics.description: Entering the US national stage from a foreign-origin PCT application via the US Receiving Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: National stage entry administrative matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entering National Stage in each foreign Receiving Office from US-origin PCT (Q41e)
rubrics_metrics.description: Entering national stage in each foreign receiving office from a US-origin PCT application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foreign national-stage entries per jurisdiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paying an annuity or maintenance fee abroad (Q41f)
rubrics_metrics.description: Handling payment of annuities or maintenance fees in foreign jurisdictions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foreign maintenance/renewal administrative task.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent application amendment/argument, minimal complexity, foreign counsel/client provides detailed response instructions (Q41g)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing a minimal-complexity amendment/argument where foreign counsel or the client supplies detailed response instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lower-effort foreign prosecution when instructions are detailed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent application amendment/argument, relatively complex biotechnology/chemical, where foreign counsel/client provides detailed response instructions (Q41h)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing a relatively complex amendment/argument in biotechnology/chemical where foreign counsel or client provides detailed response instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tech- and complexity-specific foreign prosecution with provided instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent application amendment/argument, relatively complex electrical/computer, with detailed foreign instructions (Q41i)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing a relatively complex amendment/argument in electrical/computer arts where foreign counsel or client provides detailed response instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tech- and complexity-specific foreign prosecution with provided instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent application amendment/argument, relatively complex mechanical, with detailed foreign instructions (Q41j)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing a relatively complex amendment/argument in mechanical arts where foreign counsel or client provides detailed response instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tech- and complexity-specific foreign prosecution with provided instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing US origin utility patent application in foreign office, ready for filing with formal papers, assignment, priority documents (Q42a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Filing a US-origin utility patent application in a foreign office when received ready for filing with required formal papers, assignment, and priority documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foreign filing of US-origin matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entering National Stage in foreign Receiving Office from US-origin PCT application (Q42b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Entering the national stage in a foreign receiving office from a US-origin PCT application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foreign national-stage entry for US-origin PCTs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paying an annuity or maintenance fee abroad (Q42c)
rubrics_metrics.description: Paying annuity/maintenance fees in foreign offices (Europe/other jurisdictions grouped in filing-US-abroad section).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foreign maintenance administrative task.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent application amendment/argument of minimal complexity where US counsel provides foreign counsel detailed response instructions (Q42d)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation of minimal-complexity amendments/arguments abroad where US counsel or client provides detailed instructions to foreign counsel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordination/outsourcing category for foreign prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent application amendment/argument, relatively complex biotechnology/chemical, where US counsel provides instructions to foreign counsel (Q42e)
rubrics_metrics.description: Relatively complex biotech/chemical amendment/argument handled abroad with instructions from US counsel or client.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foreign prosecution with US-origin instructions; tech-specific.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent application amendment/argument, relatively complex electrical/computer, where US counsel provides instructions to foreign counsel (Q42f)
rubrics_metrics.description: Relatively complex electrical/computer amendment/argument handled abroad with instructions from US counsel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foreign prosecution with US-origin instructions; tech-specific.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent application amendment/argument, relatively complex mechanical, where US counsel provides instructions to foreign counsel (Q42g)
rubrics_metrics.description: Relatively complex mechanical amendment/argument handled abroad with instructions from US counsel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foreign prosecution with US-origin instructions; tech-specific.

rubrics_metrics.name: Surcharge to clients for handling invoices from foreign counsel (Q42H)
rubrics_metrics.description: A surcharge charged to clients for the law firm's handling of invoices from foreign counsel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative billing/overhead charge; sub-items: fixed fee (Q42H1) and percentage (Q42H2).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee charged to clients for handling invoices from foreign counsel (Q42H1)
rubrics_metrics.description: A fixed fee charged to clients for handling foreign counsel invoices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific billing method for invoice handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentage charged to clients for handling invoices from foreign counsel (Q42H2)
rubrics_metrics.description: A percentage-based charge to clients for handling invoices from foreign counsel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternative billing method for invoice handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: US design patent application (Preparation and Filing) (Q43a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation and filing of a US design patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design patent prosecution matter-type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal drawings for design patent application (Q43b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing formal drawings required for a design patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specialized drawing task for design patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparing and filing international design patent application under the Hague agreement (Q43c)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing and filing an international design patent application under the Hague Agreement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: International design filing matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responding to Office action in design patent application (Q43d)
rubrics_metrics.description: Responding to an Office action in a design patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design prosecution response task.

rubrics_metrics.name: US plant patent application (Preparation and Filing) (Q43e)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation and filing of a US plant patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plant patent prosecution matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright registration application (Preparation and Filing) (Q43f)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation and filing of a copyright registration application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-patent IP filing matter included in the catalog.

rubrics_metrics.name: Due Diligence (Transactional Work) (Q44a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Conducting due diligence related to IP/transactions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transactional IP work item; often used in M&A or licensing contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparing licenses, including negotiations (Q44b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Drafting and negotiating license agreements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transactional licensing matter including negotiation time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litigation – Initial case management by amount at risk (e.g., < $1M, $1–$10M, $10–$25M, > $25M) (Q45Aa, Q45Ae, Q45Ai, Q45Am, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Initial case management phase of patent litigation, categorized by amount at risk tiers (less than $1M; $1–$10M; $10–$25M; greater than $25M).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to scale effort/costs by dispute size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litigation – Inclusive of discovery, motions, and claim construction by amount at risk (Q45Ab, Q45Af, Q45Aj, Q45An, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Litigation phase inclusive of discovery, motions practice, and claim construction, categorized by amount at risk tiers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mid‑case litigation workload category for pricing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litigation – Inclusive of pre‑trial, trial, post‑trial, and appeal by amount at risk (Q45Ac, Q45Ag, Q45Ak, Q45Ao, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Litigation phase covering pre-trial, trial, post-trial, and appeal where applicable, categorized by amount at risk tiers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Full-lifecycle litigation cost category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litigation – Cost of mediation by amount at risk (Q45Ad, Q45Ah, Q45Al, Q45Ap, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Cost associated with mediation in patent litigation, scaled by amount at risk tiers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternative dispute-resolution cost item.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litigation – Hatch‑Waxman Act matters by amount at risk (Q45Ba–Q45Bp)
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent litigation specifically under the Hatch‑Waxman/ANDA context, broken down by amount at risk and litigation phases (initial management, discovery/motions/claim construction, trial/appeal, mediation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specialized pharmaceutical litigation category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litigation – Defending claims of patent infringement by Non‑Practicing Entity (NPE) by amount at risk (Q45Ca–Q45Cp)
rubrics_metrics.description: Defense of patent infringement claims asserted by NPEs, segmented by amount at risk and litigation phases (initial management, discovery, trial, mediation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NPE-specific defense workload categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litigation – Section 337 patent infringement by amount at risk (Q45Da–Q45Dp)
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent infringement litigation before the ITC under Section 337, categorized by amount at risk and phase.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ITC/Section 337 procedural cost categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Infringement – Correlation between amount at risk and attorney hours required (Q45E)
rubrics_metrics.description: A metric correlating the financial amount at risk with the overall attorney hours required to litigate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Analytic metric for estimating staffing/hours vs. dispute value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total cost of asserting compared to total cost of defending (Q45F)
rubrics_metrics.description: Metric comparing total costs for a plaintiff asserting a patent versus costs for a defendant defending against the claim.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comparative cost metric for strategy/budgeting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost of asserting as percent of cost of defending (Q45Fx)
rubrics_metrics.description: The cost of asserting a patent expressed as a percentage of the cost of defending.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Normalized comparative metric to assess cost asymmetry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post‑Grant Proceedings (PGR/IPR) – Life Sciences by type of practice (through filing, motion practice, PTAB hearing, appeal) (Q46Ai–Q46Aiv)
rubrics_metrics.description: Post-grant proceedings (Petitions for PGR/IPR) in life sciences, with separate cost/work items for through filing petition, through end of motion practice, through PTAB hearing, and through appeal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PTAB matter lifecycle broken into discrete phases for pricing by practice area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post‑Grant Proceedings (PGR/IPR) – Electrical/Computer by location/type (through filing, motion practice, PTAB hearing, appeal) (Q46Ai–Q46Aiv)
rubrics_metrics.description: Post-grant proceedings in electrical/computer arts, with costs/work items for through filing, motion practice, PTAB hearing, and appeal, broken out by location or type of practice as applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tech-specific PTAB cost categories.
